findings.title: Imported feed and remote HTML bypasses all post sanitization
findings.body: `TopicEmbed.import` creates posts with `cook_method: raw_html`, and `Post#cook` returns that raw value unchanged. RSS `i.content` and readability output are external, attacker-controlled HTML, and the embed view later renders `raw post.cooked`. A malicious or compromised feed/article can therefore persist script/event-handler markup in a topic and execute it for forum and embedded-page visitors. Imported content must be sanitized with the same allowlist/sanitizer used for posts before it is stored or rendered; merely bypassing the cooking pipeline is unsafe.

findings.title: Remote importer follows redirects to unvalidated hosts
findings.body: The requested embed URL is host-checked before retrieval, but `open(url).read` follows HTTP redirects without revalidating the destination. An attacker can request a URL on the configured embeddable host that redirects to an internal service or cloud metadata endpoint, causing the server-side importer to fetch that resource (SSRF). Redirect destinations must be disabled or each redirect target must be parsed, host/IP validated, and restricted before fetching.

findings.title: Resize postMessage uses the full Referer as target origin
findings.body: `request.referer` normally includes a path and query string, but `postMessage` target origin must match the embedding window's origin. Passing a value such as `https://example.com/article?id=1` will not match the parent origin `https://example.com`, so the resize message is rejected and the iframe remains at its default height. Parse the referer and pass only its scheme/host/port origin.

findings.title: Controller spec asserts a retrieval path the controller no longer implements
findings.body: The test expects `TopicRetriever.new(...).retrieve`, but `EmbedController#best` actually calls `Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ...)` when no embed exists. This expectation will fail rather than testing the implemented asynchronous behavior. The spec should assert the enqueued job and its arguments (and separately test `Jobs::RetrieveTopic` invokes `TopicRetriever`), otherwise the added test suite cannot pass and does not protect the actual contract.
